scope: XMemGetTitleHeap ordinal 14 and ordinary XMemCreateWin32Heap ordinal 4 modes on CPU host heaps. Xbox partition ownership and caller-supplied-memory heaps are not implemented.
native_method: Runs the hash-pinned console routines in a temporary mapped PE, replacing XbGetPartitionHeap and XbCreatePartitionHeap with argument-checking native callbacks; console diagnostic logging and SetLastError are stubbed for invalid cases. The title getter forwards partition=1 and the creator with modes 0/4 forwards (1,3/2,NULL,1). The original strips bit 0x8000 and ignores the second argument for those modes. Null/unaligned mode-2 base, combined mode 6 and invalid mode 8 return error 87.
native_result: xmem-native-heaps PASS title=1 create=5 flags=3/2 invalid=4
guest_checks: Get title heap and verify that HeapAlloc allocations can be freed with XMemFreeDefault and XMemAllocDefault allocations can be freed with HeapFree.
Create four independent heaps with modes 0/4 and optional bit 0x8000, allocate/write/free and destroy each; reject unsupported mode2 and invalid arguments.
limits: The Xbox title partition heap is replaced by the process heap. Xbox physical partition ownership, memory budgets and GPU visibility are not emulated.
Only ordinary modes 0 and 4 are implemented. Supported modes ignore base as observed; custom-base mode 2 and console-partition modes are rejected.
The real console partition allocator is stubbed in the native reference control; hardware memory backing and allocation failures are not compared.
